source.title: First Nation Profiles: List of First Nations, wildcard name search
source.date_modified_scope_note: Displayed site Date modified, not an established date for each directory record or for the 619 count.
source.source_edition: Unversioned public web directory snapshot observed on 2026-10-12. No declared record-level edition or effective date found.
source.html_metadata_note: The older shared HTML metadata date differs from visible Date modified. Neither is assigned as the record-level data as_of date.

scope_note: Profile directory rows returned by the official wildcard search, observed on retrieval date. Not a verified count of current governments or all Canadian Indigenous peoples. Inuit, Metis and broader peoples require separate inventories.
extraction_note: Two links per row identify the same source BAND_NUMBER. Numeric profile number and exact displayed source name are preserved. No address, inferred province, legal recognition finding or automatic identity match is added. Only outer whitespace surrounding source labels is trimmed; one source anchor has a trailing space.

count_discrepancy.note: The landing page reports 619 First Nations while the public wildcard search returned 638 distinct profile-number records. These are not automatically equivalent units. No cause has been established and no record is removed to fit the headline count.

checks.pagination_note: All rows present in one server-rendered tbody; no server-side pager or next-page link found.
checks.independent_extraction: HTMLParser row/cell parsing exactly matches separate row/link regex extraction for all 638 source number/name pairs.

source_label_outer_whitespace.note: One trailing source-anchor space trimmed for the displayed name. Internal text and punctuation unchanged.

checks.source_glyph_note: Four labels contain literal U+003F question marks in the valid UTF-8 response. No U+FFFD decode replacements found. Names are preserved; no glyph or endonym correction inferred.

historical_dataset_kept_separate.note: No identifier or name crosswalk from this dated administrative dataset was produced.

checks.source_style_note: The same-host theme declares Noto Sans for body text; custom table CSS supplies no name-specific font or glyph substitution. Icon fonts are separate. No browser rendering or font-binary validation claimed.

followup.scope: Review current source labels against the Nations own names and sources before writing or linking profiles. Keep the 2024 administrative catalogue separately typed; do not deduplicate the two catalogues as identities.
followup.batch_note: This catalogue is a durable enumeration handoff. It does not create 638 automatic queue tasks or identity matches.

review.note: Automated source retrieval and extraction are not human review or an identity determination.

as_of_scope: Retrieval snapshot date only, not an effective date for government recognition or individual directory records.
public_notes: The snapshot date is when this search was read. No effective date for individual records or for the landing-page count was established.

Four source labels contain literal question marks. They are preserved as published; preferred names and missing characters need review against the communities' own sources. No correction is invented here.
public_extraction_note: These names and profile numbers follow the public source. Preferred names and links to researched profiles still need review against each community's own evidence.
